none: PAS FindID 978598: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped rosette diademed and probably cuirassed right. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them; left standard has a triangular or conical top. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 6
